caseTitle.zh: 輸注中心：六年的「腰扭到」
caseTitle.en: Infusion unit: six years of 'pulled back'

condition.zh: 脊椎關節炎 · 發炎性背痛

title.zh: 風濕免疫科：日間輸注中心

tagline.zh: 抗體陰性的背痛，和停了四個月的點滴
tagline.en: A back pain with negative antibodies, and a drip paused for four months

desc.zh: 在輸注椅之間來回：數關節、問出發炎性背痛、讀骨盆的片子、在打生物製劑之前把該篩的都篩完。
desc.en: Move between the infusion chairs: count joints, recognise inflammatory back pain, read the pelvic films, and complete the screening before any biologic starts.

desc.zh: 核對藥物、調整輸注速度、坐在病人看得到的地方。輸注反應的第一聲咳嗽，是你聽到的。
desc.en: Check the drug, set the infusion rate, sit where patients can see you. The first cough of an infusion reaction is the one you hear.

about.zh: 每天騎腳踏車上班的風濕科主治。對脊椎關節炎的病人，他開的第一張處方永遠是「動起來」。
about.en: A rheumatologist who cycles to work every day. For spondyloarthritis, his first prescription is always 'move'.

about.zh: 記得每一張輸注椅上的人愛吃什麼點心。過敏急救盒永遠放在她伸手就拿得到的地方。
about.en: Knows which snack every infusion-chair regular likes. The reaction kit always sits within her reach.

about.zh: 28 歲軟體工程師。背痛六年，被當成「坐太久、腰扭到」，推拿過、整脊過。上個月右眼紅痛畏光，眼科說是前葡萄膜炎，轉來風濕科。（虛擬個案）
about.en: Twenty-eight, a software engineer. Six years of back pain put down to 'sitting too long, a pulled back'; massage, manipulation. Last month a red, painful, light-shy right eye: anterior uveitis, said the eye clinic, and referred him here. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 說阿哲每天早上起床都像八十歲的老伯，要「開機」很久。她把他的症狀都記在手機裡。
about.en: Says Zhe gets out of bed every morning like an eighty-year-old and takes ages to 'boot up'. She keeps his symptoms in a phone note.

role.zh: 3 號椅 · 類風濕性關節炎

about.zh: 61 歲退休裁縫，類風濕性關節炎靠定期點滴型生物製劑控制。為了照顧剛出生的孫子停了四個月，今天回來重新開始。輸注時一定在織毛衣。（虛擬個案）
about.en: Sixty-one, a retired seamstress whose rheumatoid arthritis is controlled by a regular intravenous biologic. Paused four months to care for a new grandson, and restarting today. Always knitting during infusions. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 每一支生物製劑出藥之前，他都會打電話問同一句話：「結核和 B 肝篩了沒？」
about.en: Before any biologic leaves pharmacy, he phones with the same question: 'Have TB and hepatitis B been screened?'

about.zh: 眼科的轉介單寫得很短，但最後一句很重要：「請評估脊椎關節炎」。
about.en: The eye clinic's referral is short, but its last line matters: 'please assess for spondyloarthritis'.

plain.zh: 一群主要侵犯脊椎、薦腸關節和肌腱附著點的發炎性疾病，常在年輕時開始，也會帶來眼睛、皮膚、腸道的問題。
plain.en: A family of inflammatory diseases mainly of the spine, the sacroiliac joints and where tendons attach to bone. It often begins young and can also affect the eyes, skin and gut.

plain.zh: 脊椎關節炎裡最為人知道的一種。發炎多年後，脊椎可能慢慢黏在一起變僵；早點診斷、持續運動與治療，可以減少這種變化。
plain.en: The best-known form of spondyloarthritis. After years of inflammation the spine may slowly fuse and stiffen; early diagnosis, steady exercise and treatment reduce that.

plain.zh: 跟一般「閃到腰」相反：年輕時慢慢開始、休息不會好、活動反而變好、半夜後段會痛醒、早上僵很久。
plain.en: The opposite of an ordinary strain: it creeps in at a young age, does not ease with rest, improves with movement, wakes you in the second half of the night, and makes mornings stiff for a long time.

plain.zh: 骨盆後面、脊椎最下端和骨盆連接的關節。脊椎關節炎常常從這裡開始發炎，痛在屁股深處，有時左右輪流。
plain.en: The joint at the back of the pelvis where the base of the spine meets the pelvic bones. Spondyloarthritis often starts here, felt deep in the buttock, sometimes alternating sides.

plain.zh: 磁振造影上看到骨頭裡面的發炎訊號。X 光要好幾年才看得出變化，磁振造影可以早很多看到正在發炎。
plain.en: The signal of active inflammation inside bone on MRI. An X-ray may take years to change; MRI sees the inflammation much earlier.

plain.zh: 眼睛前段發炎：紅、痛、怕光、視力模糊，通常一次一眼。要眼科治療，也是脊椎關節炎的重要線索。
plain.en: Inflammation at the front of the eye: red, painful, light-sensitive, blurred, usually one eye at a time. It needs eye treatment, and it is an important clue to spondyloarthritis.

plain.zh: 肌腱或韌帶黏在骨頭的地方發炎，例如腳跟。早上下床第一步腳跟痛，有時就是它。
plain.en: Inflammation where a tendon or ligament attaches to bone, such as the heel. A painful first step out of bed can be this.

plain.zh: 一種抽血驗的自體抗體，跟類風濕性關節炎有關。脊椎關節炎通常是陰性的，所以陰性不代表沒有發炎性關節炎。
plain.en: An autoantibody in the blood linked to rheumatoid arthritis. Spondyloarthritis is usually negative for it, so a negative result does not mean there is no inflammatory arthritis.

plain.zh: 一種跟脊椎關節炎有關的遺傳標記。陽性提高可能性，但很多陽性的人一輩子沒事，陰性也不能完全排除。
plain.en: A genetic marker linked to spondyloarthritis. Being positive raises the likelihood, but many positive people never develop it, and a negative does not fully exclude it.

plain.zh: 一個一個摸、一個一個問，記下哪幾個關節腫、哪幾個痛。每次輸注前做，才知道治療有沒有效。
plain.en: Feeling and asking about each joint in turn, recording which are swollen and which are tender. Done before each infusion, so the team knows whether treatment is working.

plain.zh: 打點滴型藥物時或之後出現的反應：癢、紅、胸悶、咳嗽、喘、血壓變化。停藥一段時間後重新開始，風險比較高。
plain.en: A reaction during or after an intravenous drug: itch, flushing, chest tightness, cough, wheeze, pressure changes. The risk is higher when restarting after a break.

plain.zh: 結核菌安靜地躲在身體裡，沒有症狀也不會傳染。開始某些生物製劑後可能醒過來，所以開始前要篩檢。
plain.en: TB bacteria lying quietly in the body, causing no symptoms and not infectious. Some biologics can wake them, so screening comes first.

text.zh: 可以躺平的大椅子，旁邊有輸液幫浦和叫人鈴。陳媽媽的 3 號椅扶手上，有一道她自己縫的小布套，放毛線針。
text.en: A big recliner that lies flat, with an infusion pump and a call bell beside it. On chair 3's armrest sits a little cloth sleeve Mrs Chen sewed herself for her knitting needles.

text.zh: 每張輸注椅都在它的一臂之內：氧氣、抽吸、急救藥依規範、一份照著唸就不會漏的流程卡。每天早上點班。
text.en: Every infusion chair is within arm's reach of it: oxygen, suction, emergency drugs per protocol, and a flow card that leaves nothing out if you read it aloud. Checked every morning.

text.zh: 輸注前、輸注中依規範定時量。血氧和血壓的變化，常常比病人說「不舒服」早一步。
text.en: Readings before and during infusion on the protocol's schedule. Changes in oxygen and pressure often come a step before the patient says 'I feel odd'.

text.zh: 骨盆 X 光和薦腸關節磁振造影並排看。X 光說的是過去幾年發生的事，磁振造影說的是現在。
text.en: Pelvic X-ray and sacroiliac MRI side by side. The X-ray tells you what has happened over years; the MRI tells you what is happening now.

text.zh: 停藥四個月，她的手指腫到拿不住毛線針；今天回來，關節計數又變多了。這隻袖子是給孫子的，她說要在下一次輸注前織完另一隻。
text.en: After four months off treatment her fingers swelled until she could not hold the needles; today's joint count was higher again. This sleeve is for her grandson, and she means to finish the other one before her next infusion.

name.en: What inflammatory back pain looks like

text.zh: 大多在四十歲以前慢慢開始、休息不會好、動一動反而好、半夜後段痛醒、早上僵很久。再加上一些線索：屁股深處左右輪流痛、腳跟痛、眼睛發炎、乾癬、腸道發炎、家族史。年輕人背痛超過幾個月又符合這些，要想到脊椎關節炎，而不是只說「坐太久」。
text.en: Usually starts slowly before forty, does not ease with rest, improves with movement, wakes the patient in the second half of the night, with long morning stiffness. Add the clues: deep buttock pain that alternates, heel pain, eye inflammation, psoriasis, bowel inflammation, family history. A young person with months of back pain like this needs spondyloarthritis considered, not just 'too much sitting'.

name.zh: 陰性抗體，不等於沒有關節炎

text.zh: 類風濕因子是為類風濕性關節炎設計的線索，脊椎關節炎通常是陰性。抽血是幫忙，不是判決。診斷靠的是症狀的模式、身體檢查、影像（尤其早期的磁振造影）和其他線索拼在一起。
text.en: Rheumatoid factor is a clue designed for rheumatoid arthritis; spondyloarthritis is usually negative. Blood tests help; they do not deliver verdicts. Diagnosis rests on the pattern of symptoms, examination, imaging (especially early MRI) and the other clues taken together.

text.zh: 生物製劑會降低某些感染的抵抗力。開始之前：確認診斷與疾病活動度、篩檢結核與 B 肝 C 肝、看胸部 X 光、檢視疫苗、必要時先處理潛伏感染，並教病人哪些徵兆要馬上回來。停藥一段時間後重新開始，要評估輸注反應的風險、依規範準備。
text.en: Biologics lower resistance to some infections. Before starting: confirm the diagnosis and disease activity, screen for TB and hepatitis B and C, review a chest X-ray and vaccinations, treat latent infection first when needed, and teach which warning signs mean come back at once. When restarting after a break, assess the risk of an infusion reaction and prepare per protocol.

note.zh: 今天的椅子與一張眼科轉介
note.en: Today's chairs and one eye-clinic referral

guide.en: Read today's chairs on the board

sub.zh: 前葡萄膜炎，請評估脊椎關節炎
sub.en: Anterior uveitis: please assess for spondyloarthritis

lines.zh: 阿寧。今天六張椅子。3 號陳媽媽，停了四個月今天重新開始。另外眼科轉來一位阿哲，加在會談室。
lines.en: Ning. Six chairs today. Chair 3 is Mrs Chen, restarting after four months off. And the eye clinic has sent us a Zhe, slotted into the side room.

lines.zh: 前葡萄膜炎轉風濕科，轉介單最後一行很重要。你讀給我聽。
lines.en: Anterior uveitis referred to rheumatology: the last line of that referral matters. Read it to me.

lines.zh: 「背痛多年，請評估脊椎關節炎。」
lines.en: 'Years of back pain. Please assess for spondyloarthritis.'

lines.zh: 每天第一件事：急救盒點班。氧氣、抽吸、流程卡、藥依規範都在、效期都對。今天 3 號椅停藥後重新開始，我把盒子推近一點。
lines.en: First job every day: check the reaction kit. Oxygen, suction, flow card, drugs per protocol all present and in date. Chair 3 is restarting after a break today, so the kit moves a little closer.

q.zh: 找到過敏急救盒，確認放在 3 號椅一臂之內
q.en: Find the reaction kit and make sure it is within arm's reach of chair 3

post.zh: 好了。陳媽媽的毛線也到了，她比藥先到。
post.en: Done. Mrs Chen's knitting has arrived; it got here before the drug.

note.zh: 關節計數，停藥後的重新開始
note.en: A joint count; restarting after a break

lines.zh: 孫子出生，我去幫忙坐月子，點滴就停了。手指腫到拿不住毛線針，你摸摸看。
lines.en: My grandson was born and I went to help, so the infusions stopped. My fingers swelled until I couldn't hold the needles. Feel them.

lines.zh: 關節計數一個一個來，腫和痛分開記。今天的數字，是以後每一次的基準。
lines.en: Joint count one at a time, swelling and tenderness recorded separately. Today's numbers are the baseline for every later visit.

post.zh: 兩手掌指和近端指間關節，好幾個軟腫、壓痛。比四個月前多。
post.en: Several knuckle and middle finger joints on both hands are soft, swollen and tender. More than four months ago.

lines.zh: 其實吃止痛藥就沒那麼痛了，所以我想說慢慢來也沒關係。
lines.en: Actually the painkillers take the edge off, so I thought there was no hurry.

lines.zh: 痛少了，腫還在、毛衣織不了。這兩件事，哪一件告訴我們疾病的真實狀態？
lines.en: Less pain, but still swollen and unable to knit. Which of those tells us the true state of the disease?

post.zh: 腫脹和功能。止痛藥可以蓋住痛，蓋不住發炎。
post.en: The swelling and the function. Painkillers can cover the pain; they cannot cover the inflammation.

guide.zh: 決定怎麼重新開始輸注
guide.en: Decide how to restart the infusion

lines.zh: 停了四個月，今天照上次的單子直接打嗎？
lines.en: Four months off. Do we just run it on the old order sheet today?

q.zh: 點滴型生物製劑停了四個月，今天重新開始。你怎麼做？
q.en: An intravenous biologic paused for four months restarts today. What do you do?

options.zh: 依規範評估反應風險，備藥、慢速、密切監測
options.en: Assess reaction risk per protocol; prepare, start slowly, monitor closely

why.zh: 停藥一段時間後重新開始，輸注反應的風險比較高。先問過去反應與過敏、確認沒有感染，依規範前置用藥、從慢速開始、急救盒在旁邊。
why.en: Restarting after a break carries a higher risk of an infusion reaction. Ask about previous reactions and allergies, confirm no infection, premedicate and start slowly per protocol, with the kit beside the chair.

options.zh: 照上次的單子，直接打完
options.en: Run it exactly as last time

why.zh: 四個月前的單子，不知道這四個月發生了什麼：有沒有感染、身體有沒有對藥產生抗體。重新開始要重新評估。
why.en: A four-month-old order knows nothing about the four months since: any infection, any antibodies to the drug. Restarting means reassessing.

options.zh: 既然停了，就改回只吃止痛藥
options.en: Since it stopped, switch to painkillers only

why.zh: 她的關節計數正在變多。只吃止痛藥，發炎會繼續在關節裡留下損傷。
why.en: Her joint count is rising. On painkillers alone the inflammation keeps damaging her joints.

post.zh: 好，慢慢來。反正我織一排要很久。
post.en: Fine, slowly then. One row of knitting takes me ages anyway.

note.zh: 六年的腰扭到，是發炎性背痛
note.en: Six years of 'pulled back' is inflammatory back pain

lines.zh: 背痛六年了，大家都說我坐太久。診所驗過類風濕因子，陰性，醫師說不是關節炎。
lines.en: Six years of back pain, and everyone says I sit too much. A clinic checked rheumatoid factor, negative, so the doctor said it isn't arthritis.

lines.zh: 休息會比較好，還是動一動比較好？半夜會不會痛醒？早上要多久才鬆開？
lines.en: Is it better with rest, or with moving? Does it wake you at night? How long until you loosen up in the morning?

lines.zh: 週末躺一整天反而更痛。半夜三四點痛醒，起來走一走才好。屁股深處痛，有時左邊、有時右邊。
lines.en: Lying around all weekend makes it worse. It wakes me around three or four, and only walking about helps. Deep in the buttock, sometimes left, sometimes right.

lines.zh: 他早上下床像八十歲的阿伯，要開機很久。還有，他腳跟也會痛，下床第一步都在跳。
lines.en: Getting out of bed he's like an eighty-year-old, takes ages to boot up. And his heels hurt; he hops on his first step every morning.

post.zh: 對：抗體陰性，不能單獨排除。脊椎關節炎本來就常是陰性。阿哲剛剛講的，是教科書上的發炎性背痛。
post.en: Right: a negative antibody cannot exclude it on its own. Spondyloarthritis is usually negative anyway. What Zhe just described is textbook inflammatory back pain.

post.zh: 腳跟痛是附著點炎，眼睛是前葡萄膜炎。三條線指向同一個地方。
post.en: The heels are enthesitis, the eye was anterior uveitis. Three threads pointing to one place.

lines.zh: 問完了，換手。腰往前彎、往旁邊彎、深呼吸看胸廓、壓腳跟。哪一個你覺得最常被漏掉？
lines.en: History done; hands now. Bend forwards, bend sideways, a deep breath to watch the chest expand, press the heels. Which of those is missed most often?

lines.zh: 腳跟。他一壓阿基里斯腱附著的地方就縮腳。腰往前彎的幅度也比同年紀的人小。
lines.en: The heels. He pulls away when I press where the Achilles tendon attaches. And his forward bend is shorter than you'd expect at his age.

lines.zh: 推拿師傅從來沒壓過我的腳跟。
lines.en: My massage therapist never once pressed my heels.

note.zh: X 光幾乎正常，磁振造影在發炎

lines.zh: 他兩年前在外院照過骨盆 X 光，報告寫「正常」。上週也做了薦腸關節磁振造影。兩張一起看。
lines.en: He had a pelvic X-ray elsewhere two years ago, reported 'normal'. And a sacroiliac MRI last week. Look at them together.

question.zh: 阿哲的骨盆 X 光幾乎正常，這能排除脊椎關節炎嗎？磁振造影要找什麼？
question.en: Zhe's pelvic X-ray is almost normal. Does that exclude spondyloarthritis? What does the MRI look for?

answer.zh: 不能。X 光上的薦腸關節侵蝕、硬化、融合要發炎好幾年才看得到；早期常常正常，稱為「非放射學」的脊椎關節炎。磁振造影找的是薦腸關節旁邊的骨髓水腫，代表現在正在發炎。HLA-B27 可以當輔助線索，但不是診斷本身。
answer.en: No. Erosion, sclerosis and fusion of the sacroiliac joints take years of inflammation to show on X-ray; early disease is often normal, called 'non-radiographic' spondyloarthritis. The MRI looks for bone marrow oedema beside the sacroiliac joints, meaning inflammation now. HLA-B27 is a supporting clue, not the diagnosis itself.

post.zh: 兩側薦腸關節旁都有骨髓水腫，右邊比較明顯。X 光說「還沒壞」，磁振造影說「正在燒」。
post.en: Bone marrow oedema beside both sacroiliac joints, clearer on the right. The X-ray says 'not damaged yet'; the MRI says 'burning now'.

post.zh: 所以「還沒壞」的時候診斷，就是最好的時間。
post.en: Which is why diagnosing it while it is 'not damaged yet' is the best time there is.

note.zh: 輸注反應：停、叫、給氧、依規範
note.en: Infusion reaction: stop, call, oxygen, protocol

lines.zh: 陳媽媽剛咳了兩聲，說喉嚨癢、胸口緊。速度本來就慢，急救盒在手邊，我先停了。
lines.en: Mrs Chen just coughed twice and says her throat itches and her chest is tight. We were running slowly, the kit is right here, and I've stopped it.

lines.zh: 陳媽媽在喘，臉很紅，一直咳。照舊單子的速度打了一半。急救盒在另一頭，我去推。
lines.en: Mrs Chen is wheezing, flushed, coughing hard. Half the bag has gone in at the old rate. The kit is at the far end; I'm fetching it.

guide.en: Read the monitor, treat the reaction

lines.zh: 監視器上，陳媽媽的血氧往下掉，聽得到細細的喘鳴。毛線針掉在地上。
lines.en: On the monitor Mrs Chen's oxygen is falling, and a thin wheeze is audible. A knitting needle clatters to the floor.

options.zh: 停輸注、叫人、給氧，依規範處理過敏
options.en: Stop the infusion, call for help, oxygen, treat per protocol

why.zh: 輸注反應的第一步永遠是停藥。叫人、給氧、監測、依規範用藥，保留靜脈管路並換新的輸液管，準備好往嚴重過敏的流程升級。
why.en: Step one in any infusion reaction is stopping the drug. Call for help, oxygen, monitor, drugs per protocol, keep the IV access with fresh tubing, and be ready to escalate to the anaphylaxis pathway.

options.zh: 調慢速度，把剩下的打完
options.en: Slow it down and finish the bag

why.zh: 血氧在掉的時候，藥還在進去，反應會繼續加重。先停，穩定之後再由醫師決定能不能、怎麼再試。
why.en: With the oxygen falling, more drug means a worse reaction. Stop first; once she is stable the doctor decides whether, and how, to try again.

why.zh: 這不是感冒的咳嗽，是過敏反應的開始。觀察的同時，藥還在打。
why.en: This is not a cold; it is the start of an allergic reaction. While you observe, the drug is still running.

post.zh: ……好多了。胸口鬆開了。對不起，毛線針掉了。
post.en: ...Much better. My chest has loosened. Sorry, I dropped my needle.

post.zh: 血氧回來了。今天不再試，下次依規範調整準備，換一個方案也可以討論。
post.en: Oxygen is back. No more today; next time we prepare differently per protocol, and a different option is also on the table.

guide.en: Document the reaction; stay with Mrs Chen

lines.zh: 反應時間、症狀、處理、恢復時間，全部寫進紀錄，過敏欄位也更新。下一個打這支藥的人，就看得到。
lines.en: Time of reaction, symptoms, treatment, time to recovery: all documented, and the allergy field updated. Whoever gives this drug next will see it.

lines.zh: 阿寧，我觀察的這段時間，可以繼續織嗎？
lines.en: Ning, while you're watching me, can I carry on knitting?

lines.zh: 可以，只要妳坐在我看得到的地方。
lines.en: Yes, as long as you sit where I can see you.

note.zh: 先運動與消炎藥，生物製劑先篩檢
note.en: Exercise and NSAIDs first; screening before biologics

guide.en: Take the pharmacist's call; plan screening

sub.zh: 阿哲如果要用生物製劑，篩了沒？
sub.en: If Zhe may need a biologic: screened yet?

lines.zh: 小羅。聽說會談室有一位可能以後要用生物製劑。結核和 B 肝篩了沒？我先問，免得到時候卡住。
lines.en: Lo. I hear someone in the side room may need a biologic later. TB and hepatitis B screened? Asking now so nothing stalls later.

lines.zh: 第一線先用消炎止痛藥依醫囑，加上每天運動。效果不夠才考慮生物製劑。但篩檢可以先排。你排排看順序。
lines.en: First line is anti-inflammatories per orders plus daily exercise; biologics only if that is not enough. But screening can be arranged now. Put it in order.

q.zh: 考慮生物製劑之前：把步驟排對
q.en: Before considering a biologic: put the steps in order

steps.zh: 確認診斷與疾病活動度
抽血篩結核與 B 肝 C 肝
steps.en: Bloods: TB, hepatitis B and C

steps.zh: 看胸部 X 光，檢視疫苗
必要時先處理潛伏結核
steps.en: Treat latent tuberculosis first if found

steps.zh: 衛教感染徵兆後才開始
steps.en: Teach infection warning signs, then start

post.zh: 完美。結果出來前，我不會讓任何一支出藥局。
post.en: Perfect. Until the results are in, nothing leaves my pharmacy.

lines.zh: 醫師，我查網路，說最後脊椎會黏起來，整個人彎成問號。我會變那樣嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, online it says the spine fuses in the end and you bend into a question mark. Will that be me?

lines.zh: 僵直性脊椎炎嚴重的時候會，但你現在才被診斷，骨頭還沒壞。每天運動、按時用藥、戒菸，都在幫你保住脊椎。
lines.en: In severe ankylosing spondylitis it can happen, but you are being diagnosed now, before the bone is damaged. Daily exercise, regular treatment and stopping smoking all help keep your spine.

lines.zh: ……戒菸也有關？我每天寫程式都抽。
lines.en: ...Smoking matters too? I smoke all day while I code.

lines.zh: 聽到沒？醫師說的，不是我說的。明天開始我陪你晨跑。
lines.en: Hear that? The doctor said it, not me. Starting tomorrow I'm running with you in the mornings.

note.zh: 兩個人，都差點被一句話帶走
note.en: Two patients, both nearly led astray by one line

lines.zh: 白板上 3 號椅那一行，我加了紅色的「輸注反應」，下一次的準備方式等主治決定。紀錄單影本給陳媽媽帶回家。
lines.en: On chair 3's line I've added 'infusion reaction' in red; how we prepare next time waits for the attending. A copy of the record sheet goes home with Mrs Chen.

lines.zh: 晚上我留輸注熱線給她，請她回報有沒有延遲反應。
lines.en: I'll give her the infusion hotline for tonight and ask her to report any delayed reaction.

lines.zh: 今天兩個人，都差點被一句話帶走。阿哲是「抗體陰性所以不是關節炎」，陳媽媽是「不痛了所以慢慢來」。
lines.en: Two patients today, each nearly led off course by one line. For Zhe: 'antibody negative, so not arthritis'. For Mrs Chen: 'less pain, so no hurry'.

lines.zh: 看模式，不看單一數字；看腫和功能，不只看痛；停藥再開始，重新評估。這三件事，你今天都做了。
lines.en: Read the pattern, not one number; read swelling and function, not just pain; after a break, reassess before restarting. You did all three today.

lines.zh: 還有，急救盒推近一點那件事。明天開始我每張重新開始的椅子都這樣做。
lines.en: And moving the kit closer. From tomorrow I'm doing that for every restart chair.

note.zh: 陳媽媽回報：沒有延遲反應
note.en: Mrs Chen reports in: no delayed reaction

sub.en: Mrs Chen calling to report in

lines.zh: 醫師，阿寧叫我晚上打來報告。沒有起疹子、沒發燒、呼吸很順。袖子織完一半了。
lines.en: Doctor, Ning told me to call in tonight. No rash, no fever, breathing easy. Half the sleeve is done.

lines.zh: 謝謝您打來。如果晚一點起疹子、嘴唇腫、喘，或是發燒，直接去急診，帶著今天的紀錄單。
lines.en: Thank you for calling. If later on you get a rash, swollen lips, breathlessness or a fever, go straight to the ER with today's record sheet.

lines.zh: 孫子這幾天有點感冒，我還能抱他嗎？
lines.en: My grandson has a bit of a cold these days. Can I still hold him?

lines.zh: 可以抱，抱之前之後洗手。您自己如果發燒，先打電話給我們，不要等下一次輸注。
lines.en: Yes, with hand-washing before and after. If you get a fever yourself, phone us first; don't wait for the next infusion.

lines.zh: 好。下次來，我織一雙給阿寧的手套。她的手總是冰的。
lines.en: All right. Next time I'll bring Ning a pair of gloves. Her hands are always cold.

sub.zh: 看模式不看單一數字；停藥再開始要重評
sub.en: Read the pattern, not one number; reassess before any restart
